run_f_gold: run f_gold to count array elements whose values fall within a given range [x, y]
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple array inputs to verify it correctly counts elements in range
review_f_gold: review f_gold which iterates over an array and counts elements between x and y inclusive
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that counts how many elements in an array lie within a specified range
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a list comprehension instead of an explicit loop for counting
